title: Higher-order asymptotics for the energy of greedy sequences on the unit circle
summary: For the Riesz and logarithmic energies, we consider a greedy sequence $(a_n)_{n=0}^\infty$ of points on the unit circle $S^1$ constructed in such a way that for every integer $N\geq 2$, the energy of the configuration $(a_0,\ldots,a_{N-2},x)$ attains its optimal value (say $E_N$) at $x=a_{N-1}$. We derive an asymptotic expansion for $E_N$ in terms of certain bounded, oscillatory sequences $H_{N}$, $K_{N}$, and $R_{N}$ with a doubling periodicity property.
